judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` to satisfy all acceptance criteria. It goes slightly further than the reference on the signature requirement by introducing a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias in addition to renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`, which is backwards-compatible and well-aligned with the ticket. However, in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, the candidate failed to update the embedded `OrchestratorHooks` doc-block to reflect the new `afterModelResponse` signature (`totalUsage?: TotalUsageMetadata`) and also did not update `CLAUDE.md`. Additionally, the candidate left a `.lore/dod.md` tracking artifact and split some tests into a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of keeping all unit tests consolidated in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference.
